g.text: The request to /orders/7731 failed because the payment service timed out after

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: 30 s. The same timeout appears 41 times in the last hour, always after the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: connection pool reported 64 of 64 connections in use.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: Most likely cause: the pool is too small for the 14:00 batch import, which holds

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: connections for the length of each file. The first timeout follows the batch

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: start by 2.1 s on every occasion in this log.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: • Raise the pool size or give the batch import a pool of its own.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: • Compare with the 13:00 run, which finished without timeouts.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: • Check whether the payment service logged the same requests.
